tool.name: OGS: Vtu2Grid
tool.description: Reads a 3D unstructured mesh and samples it onto a structured grid of the same extent.
tool.command: ln -sf '$input' 'input.vtu'; Vtu2Grid #if str($cellsize_z) --cellsize-z '$cellsize_z' #end if #if str($cellsize_y) --cellsize-y '$cellsize_y' #end if --cellsize-x '$cellsize_x' --input 'input.vtu' --output output_1.vtu

param.label: cellsize z
param.help: edge length of cubes in z-direction (depth)

param.label: cellsize y
param.help: edge length of cubes in y-direction (latitude)

param.label: cellsize x
param.help: edge length of cubes in x-direction (longitude) or all directions, if y and z are not set

tool.help: Reads a 3D unstructured mesh and samples it onto a structured grid of the same extent. Cell properties are mapped onto the grid (sampled at the centre-points of each cube), node properties are ignored. Note, that a large cube size may result in an undersampling of the original mesh structure. Cube sizes are defines by x/y/z-parameters. For equilateral cubes, only the x-parameter needs to be set.
